intent: New review sheets using approved token style references; no approved asset replacement
sheetA:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Quackies physical board-game encounter token design study, one landscape1536x1024 presentation sheet with a clean spacious 2-by-2 grid of FOUR large tokens and clear labels underneath. Original crisp playful cartoon illustration, front-on flat printed faces, tactile 3mm cream cardboard edges with soft short contact shadows, gently rounded die-cut shapes, strong saturated category faces and thicker darker category rims. Clean warm ivory studio background, no scene or game UI, no hands, no perspective tabletop tilt, no packaging.
Input image1 is the APPROVED orange rounded-triangle Seed token: use its material, warm cream cardboard edge, dark teal illustration outlines, strong face colour and reserved cream strength badge as the family standard. Input image2 is the player-duck art style only: warm goofy cartoon expression. Do NOT include full-body player duck markers on these sheets.
Each category has ONE distinctive sturdy silhouette. Match the same maximum bounding footprint and similar visual weight across all four tokens. Each has a single unobtrusive cream strength badge at bottom centre with a precise dark-teal '1'; this is illustrative strength1, not a new rule. Big simple central illustrations must remain recognizable when small. No tiny detail, no skinny fragile projections, no chips with copied game art. Avoid photographic animals, standing3D figurines, neon, glassUI, gradients that wash out category colour, repetitive round tokens, excessive grain, or ornate filigree.
Labels are printed below each token outside the cardboard, exactly as specified, in playful rounded dark teal lettering. Header at top 'QUACKIES · ENCOUNTER STUDY'. Small footer 'Concept art · Shapes and colours for review'. Clear generous separation, all shapes fully within frame.
Sheet1 exact contents, top-left to bottom-right:
TOP LEFT 'Obstacles': an OFF-WHITE face, thick charcoal-grey rim, broad softly irregular OCTAGON silhouette. Central original picture of a chunky fallen log across two slate pebbles, a little muddy patch; a clear harmless cartoon trail obstacle. Not a resource Twig bundle, no grass-green face. Cream strength tab1 remains distinct from whiteface.
TOP RIGHT 'Seeds': ORANGE broad rounded TRIANGLE, dark burnt-orange thick rim, EXACT family reference like image1 with the three big golden grain kernels, cream badge1. This is a visual reference to the approved Seed design, not a redesigned seed; retain its distinctive overall shape and art treatment.
BOTTOM LEFT 'Tailwind': RED/coral face, thick dark-red rim, a broad rounded rightward CHEVRON/ARROW silhouette, large curved sweeping gust with two small leaves being pushed toward the arrow tip. Whimsical visible wind swirls, not a feather icon (Feathers are a separate game resource).
BOTTOM RIGHT 'Signpost': BLUE face, thick navy rim, rounded DIAMOND silhouette with cut-cardboard edge. Central chunky little wooden wayfinding sign with two pointing arms and a small green tuft, NO words written on the sign. Short signs must stay contained inside the diamond, no stand-up object.
Do not add any other tokens or category names. Four tiles exactly.
